column2: Young adult woman from Madrid, Spain, speaking Castilian Spanish with an extremely posh, spoiled, 'pija' valley-girl attitude: nasal and whiny, dramatic and over-the-top, drawn-out vowels, sighs and eye-rolls in her voice, bored and offended by everything. Comedic cartoon character voice, very expressive.
